name: ARCHIVE - AC - Quiz Video Inactivity Checker (old segment model)

parameters.query:
SELECT
  lp.contact_id,
  lp.lead_hash,
  lp.lifecycle_stage,
  lp.video_1_watched_at,
  lp.video_2_watched_at,
  lp.video_3_watched_at,
  lp.last_event_at,
  lp.form_submitted_at,
  GREATEST(
    COALESCE(lp.video_1_watched_at, '1970-01-01'),
    COALESCE(lp.video_2_watched_at, '1970-01-01'),
    COALESCE(lp.video_3_watched_at, '1970-01-01')
  ) AS last_video_at
FROM lead_profiles lp
WHERE
  lp.lifecycle_stage IN (1, 2, 3)
  AND lp.last_event_at > lp.form_submitted_at
  AND GREATEST(
    COALESCE(lp.video_1_watched_at, '1970-01-01'),
    COALESCE(lp.video_2_watched_at, '1970-01-01'),
    COALESCE(lp.video_3_watched_at, '1970-01-01')
  ) < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  AND lp.nurture_email_sent_at IS NULL
     OR GREATEST(
    COALESCE(lp.video_1_watched_at, '1970-01-01'),
    COALESCE(lp.video_2_watched_at, '1970-01-01'),
    COALESCE(lp.video_3_watched_at, '1970-01-01')
  ) > lp.nurture_email_sent_at
LIMIT 100
UPDATE lead_profiles SET nurture_email_sent_at = NOW() WHERE contact_id = '{{ $('Code - Extract Mautic Contact ID').item.json.contact_id }}'

_setupNotes.replacement: AC - Quiz Nurture Email Sender (RqKSRTgFv8mv04H2) sends nurture emails directly and protects against duplicate sends.
_setupNotes.deprecatedReason: Old segment-based Mautic campaign model. Live workflow was deactivated on 2026-06-24 because it kept calling obsolete Mautic segment URLs and is no longer part of the active nurture flow.

credentialIds.SUPABASE_POSTGRES_CRED_ID: Replace with your Supabase Postgres credential ID in n8n
credentialIds.MAUTIC_OAUTH2_CRED_ID: Replace with your Mautic OAuth2 credential ID in n8n

_setupNotes.supabaseSchema: Expects lead_profiles table with: contact_id, lead_hash, lifecycle_stage (0-4), video_1/2/3_watched_at, last_event_at, form_submitted_at, nurture_email_sent_at
_setupNotes.mauticSegments: Must have segments: ac-nurture-phase-b, ac-nurture-phase-c, ac-nurture-phase-d created before activating
_setupNotes.logic: After 24h of video inactivity, reads current lifecycle_stage and adds lead to exactly ONE Mautic segment. Mautic campaign then sends the correct email. Prevents email flood when user watches multiple videos in one session.
